# Makoons

> Makoons is India's leading preschool chain offering age-appropriate early childhood education programs from toddlers through primary school, with franchise opportunities and daycare services across multiple locations.

Makoons operates a comprehensive network of play schools and preschools across India and Asia, featuring specialized curricula including STEAM, Phonics Matrix, and skill-based learning programs. The organization combines play-based learning methodologies with structured education to support child development from ages 1-10.
